overview_description.description: Fonoa is a tax technology company that develops a global tax automation platform for digital businesses, marketplaces, SaaS providers, and multinational enterprises. The company helps organizations manage indirect tax compliance by automating processes such as tax calculation, tax ID validation, invoicing, e-invoicing, reporting, and tax return preparation across multiple jurisdictions. Its platform is designed to reduce the complexity of complying with constantly changing VAT, GST, sales tax, and other indirect tax regulations worldwide. The company provides a modular, API-first platform that integrates with existing finance, ERP, payment, and operational systems. Its solutions enable businesses to automatically determine the correct tax treatment for transactions, validate customer and supplier tax IDs, generate locally compliant invoices, and meet country-specific e-invoicing and digital reporting requirements. Fonoa supports tax operations across more than 190 jurisdictions and processes hundreds of millions of transactions annually.

about_short_description.short_description: Fonoa s a tax automation platform that utilizes AI to track tax rules, automate calculations, and maintain compliance.

product.name: Tax Engine
product.description: An API-first tax calculation engine that computes VAT, GST, sales tax, and other taxes in real-time for transactions across 200+ countries.

product.name: E-Invoicing
product.description: A single API solution for real-time reporting of transactions and generation of electronic invoices compliant with country-specific tax regulations in over 100 countries.

product.name: Returns
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates the preparation, validation, and submission of VAT, GST, and sales tax returns globally, streamlining indirect tax filings.

product.name: Lookup
product.description: A tax ID validation engine that verifies VAT, GST, and other tax identification numbers in real-time across 115+ countries via direct government database connections.

product.name: Invoicing
product.description: An API-first platform to automatically generate tax-compliant invoices, receipts, and credit notes tailored to local regulations in over 80 countries.

product.name: Data Sharing
product.description: A solution that automates compliance with digital platform reporting requirements like DAC7 by securely organizing, formatting, and submitting seller data to tax authorities globally.
